verdict.rationale: Undermind clearly supports autonomous, long-running deep literature review jobs that plan their own searches and stop only when exhausted (undermind-docs-4/16), and case-study evidence implies runs of hours rather than seconds (undermind-docs-20). It also has a notification feature, but that is documented as an alert for newly published relevant papers (undermind-docs-9), not explicitly as a 'job complete' notification for a specific deep-research run. Community reports focus on latency of minutes for standard queries (undermind-comm-14/15/16), not on a notify-on-completion workflow for the deep MCP research tool. Missing for 10: explicit documentation linking job completion to a notification/alert, and independent confirmation of true unattended multi-hour runs with completion alerts.
